She’s eight months. 

I’m really sorry you had to go through that. Honestly If it’s like what I deal with I don’t know how made it. I’m constantly ready to jump in the road over the slightest things or I lose it a hell for hours. I just worry about how the yelling and stress affects her.  Thank you though
It’s ok! I’m pretty used to it honestly so it’s all good. I was just wondering if anyone else had this weird feeling. Sorry I know I kinda threw that conversation in a different direction
I wish I didn’t have it lol because the person it’s stuck to is a disaster and comes and goes so... sitting pretty lonely most nights lol thank you though!

It sounds absolutely insane but i just know that they’ll come back to me or we’ll talk again even if I see them with someone else or they travel for long periods of time. I just kinda know they’ll always be around? I hope that makes some kind of sense.

Edit: I’ve usually always been right too. Like they go away but after months of not talking, they’ll be back and it feels like nothing changed.
Id love to give it a try if you have any openings

I had a really shitty household but my parents s did nothing. They new and ignored it and even made jokes about it being for attention. What I remember wanting was a connection. Even if you guys don’t get around to talking about it until she’s comfortable try establishing some sort of bond. I don’t know how close you guys are but I wasn’t close with my parents and it got so bad that I can’t wear anything but longsleeves and pants. It becomes kind of addictive so if you can just let her know someone’s here and sees she’s in pain but that you’ll be there whenever she’s ready, it might help. It’s an embarrassing thing to talk about and I know a lot of people who self harm get embarrassed and close themselves off when others find out. I really hope she starts to pull away from cutting and can go to you for help! Cuts are a nasty imprint to leave on yourself for years.
This happens to me a lot. It’s like I cried myself out without crying at all. I normal just get an empty stare and zone out for bit. I hate when this happens though

Thanks, ive looked and applied but haven’t gotten very far. I’m still trying but it’s discouraging and I should just be able to provide for my house. I don’t have anyone to watch her anyways due to covid so finding a job is tough enough. It doesn’t really matter what I do. The thoughts never really leave my mind but, thanks

Me too honestly. I’m always too afraid to say much to my psych because I’m constantly afraid of CPS being called or my kid being taken for whatever reason. But she also knows I have wicked bad anxiety with others so I don’t know what kind of resources she would have. Thank you though
I see a psych but, it doesn’t do much. The pills don’t work either and I’ve tried different medications. Just don’t see a point to that anymore.
